name: docx
description: Word documents (.docx, .docm, .dotx): pages rendered in place — styles, tables, images, lists, headers and footers, footnotes — with zoom and fit.

suggestions.label: Proofread
suggestions.prompt: Proofread the document: fix spelling, grammar and punctuation without changing the meaning or the formatting.

suggestions.label: Make it concise
suggestions.prompt: Make the document more concise: cut repetition and filler, keep every point and the formatting.

suggestions.label: Improve the structure
suggestions.prompt: Improve the structure: clear headings, a logical order, one idea per paragraph. Keep the content.

suggestions.label: Summarize
suggestions.prompt: Summarize this document in five bullet points. Do not change the file.
